# Bitbucket Cloud answers

Nobody has a Bitbucket Cloud account to record from (decided on 2026-10-16: real trials on GitHub only), so these
answers are written **from Bitbucket's API 2.0 documentation** (developer.atlassian.com/cloud/bitbucket/rest), shape for
shape: the fields the client reads, with the values of a plausible repository (`acme/demo`). They are what the fake
server serves in `src-tauri/src/forge/bitbucket_tests.rs`. To replace by real recordings when an account is at hand
(docs/TODO-2.2.md, « À essayer en vrai »).
